description: Details of condition 2 (Lead roof and associated materials), condition 4 (Landscape and Bin Store drawings), condition 5 (Cycle Parking), condition 6 (Travel Plan), condition 7 (Structural Engineer's stair drawings and method statement), condition 8 (Method Statement and specialist recommendation), condition 12 (Plant compliance confirmation)  submitted pursuant to planning permission  00133/H/S16 dated 09/03/2018 for conservation, restoration and refurbishment of Boston Manor House to upgrade visitor facilities, in addition to the provision of flexible event and interpretation spaces, and meeting facilities. Installation of lift shaft to interior and roof of late 17th century wing of house. Structural repair, restoration and internal and external alteration of service wing to create cafe and shop space, internal lift shaft, and change of use of existing flats to self-contained business units. Associated landscaping, including removal of four trees adjacent to service wing and re-provision within the park.(and Listed Building Consent ref P/2017/4712)
